tables.name: photos
tables.custom_sql: CREATE POLICY anon_select ON photos FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING (true); CREATE POLICY owner_insert ON photos FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid()); CREATE POLICY owner_update ON photos FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid()) WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid()); CREATE POLICY owner_delete ON photos FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid());

notes: Anyone (anon + authenticated) can view the gallery. Authenticated users can upload/edit/delete only their own photos (user_id must match auth.uid()). Built-in templates can't express this combination, so it's a single 'custom' policy.
